headline: Colombia Reallocates Future Budget Funds for Bogota Metro Line 2
summary: Colombia's Ministry of Transport shifted future budget allocations for Bogota's Calle 13 and Metro Line 2 projects, with the minister warning against leaving 10 trillion pesos tied up in bank trusts.
why: Bogota's metro network represents one of Latin America's largest urban transit investments, where national funding allocations determine construction timelines and contractor cash flows.

impacts.name: Colombian Infrastructure
impacts.why: Budget reallocations aim to accelerate public execution but create friction regarding trust disbursements.
